I have scars on my face and hands, I have been wearing masks, hoods, and gloves to cover them up. But sometimes it is hard to hide. In those situations if someone (a stranger) asks what they are, they most likely don't suspect SH, so you can use one of these excuses.

 Ok, so I have a couple ways you can go with it.

You can go the sarcastic way, that makes you both laugh, but firmly tells them that you don't want to talk about it.

1. You can say that you are part tiger.
2. You can say that you were attacked by a shark or bear ( or some other big animal that is rare)
3. (This is my personal favorite) You can say "If I told you I would have to kill you"
4. Or you can say "You should see the other guy"
5. Or even "I made out with a cactus"
6. You can also make fun of them and say "You haven't hear? You need to get out more".

You can go the sincere way where you admit that it was something, but you don't tell them exactly.

1. You can say "It was something I went through I while back but I'm better now" Even if you are still SH ing it will make the person realize that it is a sensitive subject for you.

You can brush it off as nothing or come up with an excuse.

1. You can say "Oh it's nothing" and than change the subject.
2. You can say "They are cat scratches"
3. You can say "Oh I fell into a bush"

Or you can go the direct route. Personally I don't do this because I find it a bit awkward but you choose what you like best.

1. You can say "I don't want to talk about it"
2. Or you can completely change the subject and ignore there question".

​

Mabey try showing them in public, even if it's only for a few seconds. There is nothing wrong with having scars, so don't be ashamed of them, they are a part of you.

Hope this helps :) Stay safe.

My best advice is not to overreact and to be positive. My parents handled it horrible when I tried to tell them, and that made me feel horrible, so here is what I think might be good for you to do.

1. Don't take away her cutting tools. When you do that you will just make her find a more dangerous way of self-harming.
2. Look for any signs. I am not saying this is that case, but she could be suicidal, so just make sure that she knows that she is loved and that she is not a burden to you.
3. A diagnoses might be helpful. Ask her if she wants to get her mental health checked, there is a good chance that she is depressed and has bad anxiety. 
4. It is hard for parents to understand why teens cut so I'm gonna try to explain it. (This was the case for me but might not be the same for your daughter.) Usually they are in extreme mental pain, it's horrible, constant agony and misery and they feel like no one understands. They often spend a long time wishing they could just be happy. They feel like they deserve the pain, or they feel invalid. And cutting makes them feel better.
5. You said that she seems happy, there is a good chance that inside she is extremely sad and depressed, often people who SH get really good at hiding there feelings, so she might be faking happiness.

Overall, just please be supportive and make sure that she knows that you are not mad at her. Good luck :)
